subject: Redwood POC - Success criteria, kickoff & weekly nudge
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood POC - Success criteria & next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment before we kick off: 

1) Success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: average inference latency <= 200ms for 512-token requests under your 25 RPS test workload
- Cost: token cost target <= $0.004/token equivalent for bulk inference run
- Quality: automated BLEU/ROUGE-style evaluation on your labeled set yields >= 92% match to expected outputs; subjective pass by product team
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate during test window

2) Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): provide sample dataset + representative prompts; Redwood provides POC sandbox and onboarding guide
- Week 1: baseline run (your data) + Redwood tuning (batching/quant/profile)
- Week 2: run evaluation suite, share metrics and suggested config for production

3) Timelines & ownership
- Kickoff (recommended): Mon, Oct 19 — 2-week POC
- Finlytics owners: Alex Johnson (technical), Priya Rao (product)
- Redwood owners: Marissa Cole (AE), Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng), Dev Patel (Infra/setup)

4) Next steps (for this week)
- Alex: confirm kickoff date and provide sample dataset (anonymized)
- Priya: confirm top 5 success metrics and any pass/fail thresholds
- Dev/Marcus: provision sandbox and share access details

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (POC outline & checklist)

If this looks good I’ll send the formal POC plan and calendar invite for Oct 19 kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finlytics.com>

Date: 2026-10-11T18:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC - Success criteria & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes: 

- Success criteria: we like the latency and reliability targets. For quality, instead of BLEU/ROUGE we’ll use our internal F1/Exact-Match checks on the test set; pass threshold is >= 90% EM.
- Cost target: the number looks reasonable but we’ll confirm after baseline runs.
- Data: I’ll upload a 5k-row anonymized CSV with prompts + expected outputs by EOD Tuesday (Oct 13).

Kickoff on Oct 19 works for us — prefer a 60-minute session to walk through access and run the baseline.

One ask: can you include a short eval checklist (what tests you’ll run, metrics you’ll report) so we can map to our internal success dashboard?

Appreciate it,
Alex Johnson
